stages.name: SmartQuery
stages.description: Queries the Weather namespace for forecast data based on the Location parameter passed in from the API trigger. Results are returned as a flat list.

stages.name: Return
stages.description: Returns the forecast query results to the API caller.

triggers.name: APITrigger
triggers.description: Exposes the pipeline as an API endpoint. Accepts a Location string parameter to determine which weather forecast data to retrieve.

stages.name: SmartQuery
stages.description: Queries the namespace for all paths matching Weather.*.Position and returns them as a flat list.

stages.name: GetLocation
stages.description: Transforms each path by extracting the second segment as the Location using a JSONata expression.

stages.name: Return
stages.description: Returns the transformed location data to the API caller.

triggers.name: APITrigger
triggers.description: Exposes the pipeline as an API endpoint that can be called externally to retrieve weather locations.
